bullets.text: The railways denied permission for stormwater drain work in Minambakkam, raising flood risks, so the office should coordinate with authorities on alternative solutions.

Residents in Palaverkadu near Thiruvallur are forced to transport dead bodies by boat due to a lack of road access to the cremation ground, and the office must urge local bodies to build a proper road.
A new 25-year mega development plan has been announced for Chennai, Avadi, and Tambaram, so the office should review the proposed changes to guide regional urban growth effectively.
Firecracker debris caused a fire in Adambakkam that destroyed a house and eight vehicles, prompting the police to investigate while our office monitors local fire safety measures.
Power supply will be suspended in Velachery and Rajakilpakkam for maintenance work, and the office should ensure residents are notified of the scheduled outage.
Stray dogs joined residents in Avadi to protest against sewage overflow, and the office must direct municipal authorities to clear the drainage issue immediately.
Thirty sovereigns of gold were stolen from a house near Thiruvallur while the owners were away for Diwali, and the office should press the local police to step up patrols and apprehend the culprits.
Public demand is rising to fully operationalize the newly built 45 crore rupee Avadi government hospital, so the office should coordinate with health officials to expedite its opening.
MeitY launched three indigenous AI models including EKA-1 and Offline Dhīr in New Delhi, marking a major milestone in India's AI sovereignty that our office should track for state integration.
Declining student enrollment in mathematics courses across government colleges threatens Tamil Nadu's AI growth, requiring the office to consult education departments on remedial strategies.
Experts are working to integrate Tamil knowledge into AI platforms to overcome early computing challenges, and our portfolio team should support local linguistic digital initiatives.
Opposition leaders EPS, Nainar Nagenthiran, and OPS strongly condemned the state government over multiple murders during Diwali, and the office should prepare a detailed law and order status report.

A major controversy has emerged over alleged irregularities and poor-quality AI-assisted book procurements at Periyar Arivulagam, requiring the office to monitor the unfolding political investigations.
